rubric.description: (a) Traverses the whole string with a loop that handles one run at a time
(a) Counts the length of each run correctly, including the last run
(a) Appends each character followed by its count to the result
(a) Returns the correct String, including `""` for an empty string
(b) Traverses the string and compares each character with the previous one without going out of bounds
(b) Maintains the length of the current run, restarting it at 1 when a new run begins
(b) Tracks and returns the maximum run length (0 for an empty string)
(a) Loops over the candidate divisors from 1 up to but not including n
(a) Tests divisibility with `%` and accumulates the sum
(b) Calls `sumProperDivisors` and compares the result with n
(b) Returns the correct boolean for every n, including 1
(c) Loops through every value from `low` through `high` inclusive
(c) Calls `isPerfect`, counts the true results and returns the count
